notes.title: Development Book is now FREE!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that [u][b]the Development Book DLC is now included free with the base game![/b][/u]

It's accessible on the main menu (after beating the game) and as a PDF inside the game folder.

You'll get access to all the behind-the-scenes magic, staff insights, concept art, and early screenshots that went into making The Sekimeiya. It's our way of saying thank you to the community and giving everyone a deeper look into the world we created.

And if you've already purchased the DLC, we want to thank you from the bottom of our hearts for your incredible support! We're touched that you cared enough about the game to learn more about what went into making it <3

We hope you enjoy this special peek behind the curtain!

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.content:
Two years since the last patch, but we're still dedicated to improving The Sekimeiya experience!

The bulk of the changes in this patch are related to the text and dialogue.

[h2]Text Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] The entire script has been reviewed and many lines slightly tweaked or condensed to make for a smoother reading experience.
[*] Improved grammar and fewer typos.
[*] The actual information conveyed to the player has not changed, only some of its presentation.
[/list]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stats screen loads data from a local file. Unfortunately the analytics provider we were using changed their API pricing, and we found that it was not worth it to continue pulling data from their servers live. We've decided to export the stats and gave players a frozen version of it, which would be updated in future releases.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurs when jumping to a choice.
[/list]

[h2]Troubleshooting[/h2]
[list]
[*] If you attempt to load an existing save file on a line that was deleted, the game may refuse to load the save. Simply load another save, open the search screen which contains the backlog, and jump forward to your most recently unlocked line. If you do not have any other saves, starting a new game and jumping forward in the backlog will do the same thing.
[/list]

[h2]Current Work[/h2]
We're in the process of upgrading to Ren'Py 8, and the game is being modernized to use Python 3. Some of the things being worked on are:
[list]
[*] Improved controller handling. Screens are being reworked to prioritize gamepad controls. This has been challenging given they were built with mouse and keyboard in mind, but it's opened the path for...
[*] Multi-platform support. We've acquired a Steam Deck since last time, and work on console versions is on-going.
[*] Improved code base. Many bugs have been fixed and a lot of beginner mistakes reworked. Future fixes should be easier to make.
[/list]

Thank you for your support and we hope you continue to enjoy The Sekimeiya!

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.content:
Woah, it's been almost a year and a half since the last update. Time flies when you're dealing with The Sekimeiya.

This update fixes a few long-standing issues and adds better support for multiple languages.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed numerous grammar and script issues
[*] Fixed achievements. If the game didn't give you an achievement but you've already met the conditions, simply open the game and you'll be granted them instantly.
[*] Fixed playtime counter issues on Mac and Linux. The recorded playtime was abnormally low on these systems but should be fixed now.
[*] Fixed stats screen - Earlier in February the service we were using to track the stats changed its API so the game could no longer pull stats from the server. We've updated the API calls accordingly. As a failsafe in case the game doesn't connect to the stats server in the future, the game will show values that are current as of February 2023.
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added better support for multiple languages. There are no new languages right now, but the infrastructure is now there to make it easier
[/list]

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sometimes text will be doubled in the last line of the backlog. Sometimes this will cause a crash if the line contains formatting code. If it does throw an error just press "Ignore" and continue playing. You may have to advance a few lines in the game before the bug goes away.
[*] On Windows, typing text may sometimes cause letters to jitter. This effect should be minimal now, but it seems to be caused by having "Scale and Output = 125%" in Display Settings in Windows.
[/list]

[h2]Steam Deck[/h2]
Currently the game is listed as unsupported for the Steam Deck. The main reason is that moving the left joystick causes the game to freeze in the main menu. The virtual keyboard also does not display. We're looking to see if there's a solution for these but the lack of hardware makes it difficult for us to test and resolve these issues.

Thank you for your support and we hope you continue to enjoy The Sekimeiya!

notes.title: Version 1.05 + Development Book Release
notes.content:
The development book is now out! Take a look behind the scenes at the five year long development of game. It contains sketches, concept art, and an intimate retrospective with the developers of The Sekimeiya: Spun Glass. [b]Be advised that it contains spoilers, so read it [u]after[/u] completing the game![/b]

[h2]General[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various typos and flow changes
[*] Links to Discord and other URLs are now available from the start (previously required you to finish the game)
[*] Fixed crash when assigning "[" as a hotkey
[/list]

[h2]DLC (now released)[/h2]
[list]
[*] Development book appears as a main menu option after completing the game. Also available as a PDF in the game folder.
[*] Full resolution versions of the CGs and art are available in a 7z archive inside the game folder in both PNG and PSD formats.
[/list]
